payload.title: Distinctive projector and content model
payload.description: `web/projector.py` implements the Papyrus SiteProjector protocol: item pages for commentary, rulings and standing pages; listing pages (front page, tracker, Wire, commentary index, subscribe, 404, RSS, sitemap); static files; alias redirects. Listing digests are computed from item summaries so edits re-render only the pages that show them. Content model in `web/distinctive_content.py`, documented for editors in `docs/content-model.md`. Article bodies go through Markus with raw HTML off; all generated markup is escaped.
